name: Avatares AI - Admin - Catalog List All

parameters.query:
SELECT jsonb_build_object(
  'avatars', COALESCE((
    SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'id', avatar_id,
      'value', avatar,
      'label', display_name,
      'avatar', avatar,
      'avatarShort', avatar_short,
      'displayName', display_name,
      'avatarKind', avatar_kind,
      'description', description,
      'notes', notes,
      'isEnabled', is_enabled,
      'disabledAt', disabled_at,
      'disabledReason', disabled_reason,
      'createdAt', created_at,
      'updatedAt', updated_at
    ) ORDER BY display_name)
    FROM avatar_catalog
    
  ), '[]'::jsonb),

  'scenes', COALESCE((
    SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'id', scene_id,
      'value', scene,
      'label', display_name,
      'avatar', avatar,
      'scene', scene,
      'displayName', display_name,
      'description', description,
      'notes', notes,
      'isEnabled', is_enabled,
      'isActive', COALESCE(is_active, is_enabled),
      'disabledAt', disabled_at,
      'disabledReason', disabled_reason,
      'createdAt', created_at,
      'updatedAt', updated_at
    ) ORDER BY avatar, display_name)
    FROM scene_catalog
    
  ), '[]'::jsonb),

  'assetTypes', COALESCE((
    SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'id', asset_type_id,
      'value', asset_type,
      'label', display_name,
      'assetType', asset_type,
      'displayName', display_name,
      'description', description,
      'notes', notes,
      'isEnabled', is_enabled,
      'disabledAt', disabled_at,
      'disabledReason', disabled_reason,
      'createdAt', created_at,
      'updatedAt', updated_at
    ) ORDER BY display_name)
    FROM asset_type_catalog
    
  ), '[]'::jsonb),

  'workflows', COALESCE((
    SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'id', generation_workflow_id,
      'value', workflow,
      'label', display_name,
      'workflow', workflow,
      'displayName', display_name,
      'description', description,
      'notes', notes,
      'isEnabled', is_enabled,
      'disabledAt', disabled_at,
      'disabledReason', disabled_reason,
      'createdAt', created_at,
      'updatedAt', updated_at
    ) ORDER BY display_name)
    FROM generation_workflow_catalog
    
  ), '[]'::jsonb),

  'models', COALESCE((
    SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'id', generation_model_id,
      'value', model,
      'label', display_name,
      'model', model,
      'displayName', display_name,
      'provider', provider,
      'description', description,
      'notes', notes,
      'isEnabled', is_enabled,
      'disabledAt', disabled_at,
      'disabledReason', disabled_reason,
      'createdAt', created_at,
      'updatedAt', updated_at
    ) ORDER BY display_name)
    FROM generation_model_catalog
    
  ), '[]'::jsonb)
) AS result;
